packages.name: Nikah Only
packages.description: Perfect for intimate solemnization, or any kind of small event.

faqs.question: What is a wedding content creator?
faqs.answer: A wedding content creator captures vertical behind-the-scenes wedding moments for TikTok, Instagram Story, Threads, and WhatsApp sharing. This complements your official photographer and videographer.

faqs.question: When will we receive the content?
faqs.answer: Raw footage is delivered through Google Drive within 7 days after the event.

faqs.question: Is transportation included?
faqs.answer: Transportation fee is excluded from the estimated total and will be calculated separately based on your event, makeup, and outdoor photoshoot locations.

faqs.question: How do we secure the date?
faqs.answer: A 50% non-refundable deposit is required to reserve the date. Full balance is due 2 days before the event.
